question: What is the meaning of prefabrication in relation to waste scenario technical data?
description: Prefabrication in relation to waste scenario technical data refers to the process of manufacturing building components off-site in a controlled environment before transporting them to the construction site for assembly. This method helps reduce waste generation during construction by optimizing material usage and minimizing on-site cutting and trimming.
